phrase.payroll_with_pension: For a gross salary of {gross} GEL, the employee takes home {net} GEL. You withhold {pension} GEL for their pension (2%) and {tax} GEL income tax (20% of what's left). On top of the salary you also pay a {employer_pension} GEL employer pension contribution, so this salary costs you {cost} GEL in total.
phrase.payroll_no_pension: For a gross salary of {gross} GEL, the employee takes home {net} GEL after {tax} GEL income tax (20%). No pension contributions apply, since they're not in the funded pension scheme.
phrase.payroll_ask: Sure, I can work that out. What is the gross monthly salary?
phrase.vat_yes: Yes, you need to register for VAT. Your taxable sales over the last 12 months are above GEL 100,000, so you have 2 business days to apply to the tax authority (Revenue Service). VAT applies starting with the sale that took you over the limit.
phrase.vat_no: No, you don't need to register.
phrase.vat_depends: It depends on your turnover. Registration becomes mandatory once taxable sales over any 12 consecutive months exceed GEL 100,000.
phrase.vat_inclusive: {gross} GEL including VAT contains {vat} GEL of VAT, so the price without VAT is {net} GEL. (VAT is 18% of the net price, which is 18/118 of a VAT-inclusive total.)
phrase.vat_exclusive: VAT at 18% on {net} GEL is {vat} GEL, so the total with VAT is {gross} GEL.
phrase.vat_ask_inclusive: Sure. Does {amount} GEL already include VAT, or does VAT come on top?
phrase.distribution: If the company pays out {amount} GEL in dividends, it owes {profit_tax} GEL profit tax: the payout is grossed up (divided by 0.85) and taxed at 15%, so the distribution costs the company {cost} GEL in total.
phrase.dividend_withheld: When paying it, you withhold {withholding} GEL dividend tax (5%), so the owner receives {net} GEL.
phrase.distribution_ask: In Georgia a company pays profit tax only when it distributes profit, not while it keeps it. The payout is divided by 0.85 and taxed at 15%, and 5% is withheld from dividends paid to individuals. How much do you want to pay out?
